corridor_notes: IMPORTANT STRUCTURAL CAVEAT: P7659 'Wuzhou Branch' merges TWO physically separate, non-contiguous sub-segments under one GEM row per the source EIA notice: (1) Mengshan section (蒙山段) = Guilin-Lipu Co. 30km + Wuzhou-Mengshan Co. 29.2km = 59.2km, ending at a new Mengshan distribution station; (2) Cangwu section (苍梧段) = Hezhou-Babu Dist. 12.6km + Wuzhou-Cangwu Co. 21.9km = 34.5km, ending at a new Cangwu distribution station. These do NOT form one continuous line -- Mengshan County and Cangwu County are ~110km apart with Wuzhou city between them, and nothing in the source describes a Mengshan-to-Cangwu connector. The start/end pair given here represents ONLY the Mengshan sub-segment (chosen as representative because it is the longer/first-listed of the two, and because its start ties into a corroborated sibling GEM pipeline). Likely tie-in point identified: GEM row P4727 'Guangxi Gas Pipeline Network' / SegmentName 'Guilin-Yangshuo-Lipu Branch' already ends at 'LNG Lipu Station, Lipu County' -- this matches the '桂林-荔浦支线 30km' leg named in the P7659 EIA notice as the Mengshan section's origin, i.e. the Mengshan section plausibly branches off the existing/planned Guilin-Yangshuo-Lipu line near Lipu. This is inference from matching place-names + distances across two independently-staged GEM rows, not a direct citation in either source -- flag for a human reviewer to confirm before drawing a route. The Cangwu sub-segment (start near Babu District, Hezhou -- 24.4155435/111.5464663 -- end near Cangwu County seat -- 23.8692290/111.5423435, both Nominatim county/district-seat proxies) is NOT represented in the start/end fields above and would need its own separate route object if GEM ever splits this row into two segments (a recommendation already on record in the prior validity pilot pass, not re-litigated here). No coordinates more precise than county/town-seat level could be sourced for either the Mengshan or Cangwu distribution stations themselves -- targeted searches for '蒙山分输站' and '苍梧分输站' by name returned nothing, and the full underlying EIA report (searched docin.com, book118.com, general web) could not be located, only the 2019-12-27 first-round public-notice summary already on file.
